panels.title: Debt by System and Category (hours)
panels.description: Color intensity = remediation effort hours. Red = highest debt. Use Host/Framework/Category filters above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  hostname,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN debt_category = 'security'                THEN effort_hours ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS security_hours,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN debt_category = 'compliance'              THEN effort_hours ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS compliance_hours,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN debt_category = 'operational'             THEN effort_hours ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS operational_hours,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN debt_category = 'critical_infrastructure' THEN effort_hours ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS crit_infra_hours,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN debt_category = 'sovereignty'             THEN effort_hours ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS sovereignty_hours,
  ROUND(SUM(effort_hours)::numeric, 1)  AS total_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN severity = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_count,
  ROUND(SUM(priority_score)::numeric, 1) AS debt_score
FROM technical_debt_items
WHERE status = 'open'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND framework IN ($framework)
  AND ('$category' = 'all' OR debt_category = '$category')
GROUP BY hostname
ORDER BY debt_score DESC

SELECT
  debt_category AS metric,
  ROUND(SUM(effort_hours)::numeric, 1) AS value
FROM technical_debt_items
WHERE status = 'open'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND framework IN ($framework)
  AND ('$category' = 'all' OR debt_category = '$category')
GROUP BY debt_category

SELECT severity AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM technical_debt_items
WHERE status = 'open'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND framework IN ($framework)
  AND ('$category' = 'all' OR debt_category = '$category')
GROUP BY severity ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT hostname AS metric, ROUND(SUM(priority_score)::numeric, 1) AS value
FROM technical_debt_items
WHERE status = 'open'
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND framework IN ($framework)
GROUP BY hostname ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Debt Trend — Open Items Over Time
panels.description: Tracks open debt items by category over time. Declining lines indicate successful remediation.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('day', last_seen) AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN debt_category = 'security'    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS security,
  SUM(CASE WHEN debt_category = 'compliance'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS compliance,
  SUM(CASE WHEN debt_category = 'operational' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS operational
FROM technical_debt_items
WHERE last_seen BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND framework IN ($framework)
  AND ('$category' = 'all' OR debt_category = '$category')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Remediation Progress — Resolved vs New
panels.description: New debt items vs. resolved items per day. Goal: resolved > new (net positive trend).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('day', first_seen) AS time,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open')     AS new_items,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'resolved') AS resolved
FROM technical_debt_items
WHERE first_seen BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND framework IN ($framework)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 25 Remediation Items (sorted by priority)
panels.description: Quick wins (green) = under 4 hours. Focus here first for maximum risk reduction per dollar.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  tdi.hostname,
  tdi.framework,
  tdi.debt_category,
  tdi.severity,
  tdi.complexity,
  tdi.effort_hours,
  ROUND((tdi.effort_hours * COALESCE(rr.hourly_rate_usd, 185))::numeric, 0) AS est_cost,
  ROUND(tdi.priority_score::numeric, 1) AS priority_score,
  LEFT(tdi.violation, 120)              AS violation
FROM technical_debt_items tdi
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT r2.hourly_rate_usd
  FROM remediation_rates r2
  WHERE r2.tenant_id = 'default'
    AND r2.debt_category = tdi.debt_category
    AND r2.effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE
  ORDER BY r2.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1
) rr ON TRUE
WHERE tdi.status = 'open'
  AND tdi.hostname IN ($hostname)
  AND tdi.framework IN ($framework)
  AND ('$category' = 'all' OR tdi.debt_category = '$category')
ORDER BY tdi.priority_score DESC
LIMIT 25
